sample_unit: questions (11 patient-centric, 50 doctor-centric) rated by 30 patients and 8 oculoplastic surgeons

links.outcome: LLM response clarity by language (Chinese vs English) rated by patients
links.effect: Qwen2.5 exhibited superior Chinese-language clarity compared to English (P = 0.023); GPT-4o excelled in English; other cross-language differences not reported in the abstract.
links.quote: Qwen2.5 exhibited superior Chinese-language clarity compared to English (P = 0.023).

screen.reason: Evaluates LLM performance on patient- and clinician-directed ptosis questions with evaluations by oculoplastic surgeons and ptosis patients, without testing a specific operational guardrail or deployment practice.
